<summary>
Turns 31–31: Agent successfully located all module POMs that declare the test dependency com.google.testing.compile:compile-testing (common, factory, service, value).

Turns 32–39: Agent edited four module POMs:
- common/pom.xml: inserted a new <properties> block setting <java.version>1.7</java.version>, and added an <exclusions> block on the compile-testing dependency excluding com.sun:tools.
- factory/pom.xml: inserted <properties><java.version>1.7</java.version></properties>, and excluded com.sun:tools from compile-testing.
- service/pom.xml: inserted <properties><java.version>1.7</java.version></properties>, and excluded com.sun:tools from compile-testing.
- value/pom.xml: added <java.version>1.7</java.version> into existing <properties>, and excluded com.sun:tools from compile-testing.
These changes implement the earlier plan to avoid tools.jar resolution failures on JDK 9+ and bump the effective source level above 1.6.

Turns 40–42: Agent generated a combined git diff of the above edits and saved it as patch_1.diff in repo root (confirmed present).

Turns 43–44: Agent performed “git reset --hard” back to a clean HEAD, then applied patch_1.diff using “git apply”. After applying, git status showed modified: common/pom.xml, factory/pom.xml, service/pom.xml, value/pom.xml. Untracked files remain: build.pom.xml and patch_1.diff.

Turn 45: Agent reran Maven build (mvn -f build-pom.xml verify ...). The previous dependency-resolution issue appears mitigated (build progressed into compilation/testing rather than failing at dependency resolution), but new failures occurred:
1) auto-common tests: 1 failing JUnit test: VisibilityTest.effectiveClassVisibility with assertion “Not true that <DEFAULT> is equal to <PUBLIC>”, causing surefire failure for auto-common.
2) auto-factory compilation error on JDK 11: FactoryWriter.java cannot find symbol javax.annotation.Generated (package javax.annotation), indicating missing/removed annotation type on newer JDKs.
Because of these failures, the reactor banned AutoValue from building and the overall Maven build failed. </summary>
